raw:
```yaml
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: emojivoto
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: emojivoto
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: emoji-svc
  namespace: emojivoto
  labels:
    app: emoji-svc
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: emojivoto
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: emoji-svc
  ports:
    - name: grpc
      port: 8080
      targetPort: grpc
      protocol: TCP
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: emoji-svc
  namespace: emojivoto
  labels:
    app: emoji-svc
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: emojivoto
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: emoji-svc
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxUnavailable: 0
      maxSurge: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: emoji-svc
        app.kubernetes.io/part-of: emojivoto
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity:
          preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
            - weight: 100
              podAffinityTerm:
                topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
                labelSelector:
                  matchLabels:
                    app: emoji-svc
      containers:
        - name: emoji-svc
          image: buoyantio/emojivoto-emoji-svc:v11
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          env:
            - name: GRPC_PORT
              value: "8080"
          ports:
            - name: grpc
              containerPort: 8080
              protocol: TCP
          readinessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: grpc
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 3
            failureThreshold: 3
          livenessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: grpc
            initialDelaySeconds: 15
            periodSeconds: 20
            timeoutSeconds: 3
            failureThreshold: 3
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 64Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 256Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: voting-svc
  namespace: emojivoto
  labels:
    app: voting-svc
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: emojivoto
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: voting-svc
  ports:
    - name: grpc
      port: 8080
      targetPort: grpc
      protocol: TCP
    - name: prometheus
      port: 8801
      targetPort: prometheus
      protocol: TCP
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: voting-svc
  namespace: emojivoto
  labels:
    app: voting-svc
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: emojivoto
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: voting-svc
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxUnavailable: 0
      maxSurge: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: voting-svc
        app.kubernetes.io/part-of: emojivoto
      annotations:
        prometheus.io/scrape: "true"
        prometheus.io/port: "8801"
        prometheus.io/path: "/metrics"
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity:
          preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
            - weight: 100
              podAffinityTerm:
                topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
                labelSelector:
                  matchLabels:
                    app: voting-svc
      containers:
        - name: voting-svc
          image: buoyantio/emojivoto-voting-svc:v11
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          env:
            - name: GRPC_PORT
              value: "8080"
            - name: PROM_PORT
              value: "8801"
          ports:
            - name: grpc
              containerPort: 8080
              protocol: TCP
            - name: prometheus
              containerPort: 8801
              protocol: TCP
          readinessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: grpc
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 3
            failureThreshold: 3
          livenessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: grpc
            initialDelaySeconds: 15
            periodSeconds: 20
            timeoutSeconds: 3
            failureThreshold: 3
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 64Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 256Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: web
  namespace: emojivoto
  labels:
    app: web
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: emojivoto
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: web
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 8080
      targetPort: http
      protocol: TCP
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
  namespace: emojivoto
  labels:
    app: web
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: emojivoto
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxUnavailable: 0
      maxSurge: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
        app.kubernetes.io/part-of: emojivoto
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity:
          preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
            - weight: 100
              podAffinityTerm:
                topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
                labelSelector:
                  matchLabels:
                    app: web
      containers:
        - name: web
          image: buoyantio/emojivoto-web:v11
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          env:
            - name: WEB_PORT
              value: "8080"
            - name: EMOJISVC_HOST
              value: "emoji-svc.emojivoto.svc.cluster.local:8080"
            - name: VOTINGSVC_HOST
              value: "voting-svc.emojivoto.svc.cluster.local:8080"
            - name: INDEX_BUNDLE
              value: "dist/index_bundle.js"
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8080
              protocol: TCP
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 3
            failureThreshold: 3
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 15
            periodSeconds: 20
            timeoutSeconds: 3
            failureThreshold: 3
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 64Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 256Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: vote-bot
  namespace: emojivoto
  labels:
    app: vote-bot
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: emojivoto
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: vote-bot
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: vote-bot
        app.kubernetes.io/part-of: emojivoto
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
      containers:
        - name: vote-bot
          image: buoyantio/emojivoto-web:v11
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          command:
            - emojivoto-vote-bot
          env:
            - name: WEB_HOST
              value: "web.emojivoto.svc.cluster.local:8080"
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 50m
              memory: 32Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 200m
              memory: 128Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: web
  namespace: emojivoto
  labels:
    app: web
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: emojivoto
spec:
  ingressClassName: nginx
  rules:
    - host: emojivoto.example.com
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service:
                name: web
                port:
                  name: http
---
apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: emoji-svc
  namespace: emojivoto
  labels:
    app: emoji-svc
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: emojivoto
spec:
  minAvailable: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: emoji-svc
---
apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: voting-svc
  namespace: emojivoto
  labels:
    app: voting-svc
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: emojivoto
spec:
  minAvailable: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: voting-svc
---
apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: web
  namespace: emojivoto
  labels:
    app: web
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: emojivoto
spec:
  minAvailable: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: default-deny-ingress
  namespace: emojivoto
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: emojivoto
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
    - Ingress
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-web-ingress
  namespace: emojivoto
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: emojivoto
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
  policyTypes:
    - Ingress
  ingress:
    - from:
        - namespaceSelector:
            matchLabels:
              kubernetes.io/metadata.name: ingress-nginx
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 8080
    - from:
        - podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app: vote-bot
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 8080
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-emoji-svc-ingress
  namespace: emojivoto
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: emojivoto
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: emoji-svc
  policyTypes:
    - Ingress
  ingress:
    - from:
        - podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app: web
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 8080
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-voting-svc-ingress
  namespace: emojivoto
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: emojivoto
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: voting-svc
  policyTypes:
    - Ingress
  ingress:
    - from:
        - podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app: web
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 8080
    - from:
        - namespaceSelector:
            matchLabels:
              kubernetes.io/metadata.name: monitoring
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 8801
```
